card.name: The word frequency before 'of' events
card.fires_on: The word "frequency" in drug-label text, usually after "greater", "the" or "a", where it means how often an effect occurs. It also fires on "Frequency" as a dosing table column heading.

modes.label: Frequency of effects
modes.description: "frequency" means how often an event or reaction occurs, often followed by "of" and a list of conditions.

modes.description: "Frequency" is a column heading in a dosing table next to weight or age columns.
